source_caption:
“Inga fired seven bullets at Murtalo… and missed all seven!” ❤️‍🩹

In the sun-drenched streets of 1980s Tbilisi, everyone knows and loves “Kukaracha” — the warm-hearted local cop who protects the neighborhood with a smile and a firm sense of justice. But when a ruthless gang issues a deadly threat, this everyday hero finds himself torn between duty, honor, and his growing love for a beautiful stranger. A touching mix of romance, humor, and quiet courage, Kukaracha (1982) is a beloved Georgian classic that reminds us why the smallest acts of goodness can change everything.
